package.name: erd_fri_emulator
package.description: L2 iiwa simulator: the Sunrise/robot side of FRI 1.11 over UDP (RR_01 S3.5), for testing erd_iiwa/FriPositionSystem's real driver path without the robot. Reads the bundled FRI 1.11 message definitions from the pinned iiwa_ros2 checkout at build time (ERD_FRI_SDK_ROOT); never vendors it. No ROS dependency beyond the build (plain UDP, no rclcpp).
